headline: BIG TITLE, ONE BREATH
body: Open with the title slammed across the screen. Say it out loud — if it sounds good spoken, it's a good title.

headline: Every slide earns its place
body: One idea per slide. If a slide has two ideas, it's two slides. Lightning talks live or die on pace.

headline: THE TURN
body: A single big word to mark the moment the talk changes direction. Let the room catch up.

quote: Drop in a line that isn't yours — it buys you authority and a breath.

title: That's the talk
subtitle: Your @handle. Where to find the slides. A reason to come say hi.
